title: ci(release): the post-version validation also runs the registry template's region pin

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感：发版流程里"版本 PR 打开前的校验"多跑一个只要 2 秒的测试。它检查迁移登记模板有没有给当前大版本开好区段；下一次跨大版本时，如果漏开了区段，同一次运行里就会直接报出来，不会等到版本 PR 上再红。
- 为什么做：卡 #37587 的最后一项。19 预发布那次，版本 PR 就是被这类缺口挡住的（#37549）。卡上另外两项：ui 测试已由 #38089 合入，mcp-authoring 文案已由 #37821 修好。
- 出错会怎样：只在 release.yml 的校验步骤里加了一行检查和一段注释，不碰发布、打 tag 或部署那几步；这个 job 只在定时和手动触发时跑。如果这条检查误报，版本 PR 只是暂时不刷新，撤回这一行就恢复。
- 要你做什么：这个文件按路径属于 Tier H，需要你（GOVERNED_APPROVERS）批准后，由 3 号座位落地。

## What changes
- `.github/workflows/release.yml`, job "Version PR maintenance", step "Validate the post-version tree":
  - One new content gate after the `protocol-version.test.ts` line: `run_gate pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --fail-if-no-match exec vitest run --project local scripts/build-migration-registry-entry.test.ts`. That file holds the registry template's region pin (from #37557). It checks that every migration kind has an `os-generated` region for the spec package's major and for `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`, the majors a new entry registers under.
  - The header's "WHAT IS CHECKED" list gains the entry. It says why the gate runs here: the version pass moves the spec major, so on a boundary train this is the first tree where the new major is the package's own. It also says what the gate adds next to the existing refusal of a moved `protocol-version.ts`: the same run names a missing region, rather than the run after the refusal is resolved. And it says why the other three files that reddened the 19 Version PR are not added (readings below).
- No other step, job, permission or trigger changes. Nothing publishes; no changeset.

## Tests
<details><summary>Readings at dc29936f (5746ba60 measured on origin/main 6e06729a, then cherry-picked onto 447757d0, the merge of #38089)</summary>

- Premise at 815e882b and 6e06729a: the step ran one spec test file, `src/kernel/protocol-version.test.ts` (l.825).
- The new gate's command on this tree (spec `19.0.0-next.1`, `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 19), after install and with no build, which is this job's state: `Tests  7 passed (7)`, 2.2 s.
- Ablation: with the `retired-key:19` region deleted from `registry.ts.template`, the same command exits 1: `× opens and closes 'retired-key:19'`, "src/migrations/registry.ts.template has no `<os-generated retired-key:19>` region, but major 19 is current (spec package 19.0.0-next.1, PROTOCOL_VERSION major 19)…", `Tests  1 failed | 6 passed (7)`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- <file>`; `git status --porcelain` empty.
- Measured and left out:
  - `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.retired-keys.test.ts` (repo project): `13 passed`, 132 s. Its failure on #35129 is the missing region itself, which the pin judges structurally.
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`: does not start without a build (`Failed to resolve entry for package "@objectstack/objectql"`).
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`: 2.0 s. Its version-step input is the objectui skill's `compatibility:` pin, which `check:skill-compatibility` already judges in this step.
- The workflow still parses as YAML (`yaml.safe_load`).
- At dc29936f the new gate's command reads `Tests  7 passed (7)` again.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --ran` on `.github/workflows/release.yml`: 40 derived, 40 run, every one `exit 0`, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero), 0 unrun.
</details>

<details><summary>Affected step, before and after (advisory)</summary>

- Before: "Validate the post-version tree" on the last four scheduled runs and one dispatch took 33 s, 27 s, 33 s, 27 s and 33 s (median 33 s).
- After: one more file at 2.2 s measured locally, so about +2 to 3 s. Nothing else in the job moves.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Tier H by path (`check-governed-merges.mjs`, the `release.yml` row of the workflows split). It lands only after an authorized approval, then by the owning seat.
